# ShockwavePhase enumeration

Where a released shockwave is in its life.

```csharp
public enum ShockwavePhase
```

## Values

| name | value | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Traveling | `0` | Traveling from its runner to its target, setting off the bombs and breaking the boxes it passes. |
| Blasting | `1` | Blasting at its target, pushing the runners it reaches. |
| Fading | `2` | Done pushing, while its drawing plays out. |
| Ended | `3` | Gone, or replaced by its runner's next release. |
